svg.title: PyData 2026 analytics-agent evaluation flywheel
svg.desc: Simulated users enter an Orq-hosted agent that calls guarded local tools and records traces; local evaluatorq processing replays trace-backed DataPoints through deterministic checks and four atomic judges before human review drives manual, versioned improvement.
